Yesterday the team finished migrating the old database to the new cluster. The migration took longer than expected because several tables contained inconsistent records that had to be cleaned by hand. After the cleanup, we ran the full test suite twice and compared the results against the previous release. Everything passed, so we scheduled the switchover for Saturday night when traffic is lowest. If anything goes wrong, the rollback plan is documented in the shared notebook, and two engineers will stay on call until Monday morning to watch the dashboards closely.
